description: Re-run the checker pipeline against recent COMPLETED scans (e.g. after updating policies or custom rules). Returns the number of scans queued for re-evaluation. No new crawl fee — only the checker cost.

scope_type.description: Selection mode. `last_n` = most recent N scans; `hours` = scans from the past N hours.

scope_value.description: Number of scans (`last_n`, max 5000) OR number of hours (`hours`, max 72). API enforces tighter caps per mode.

name: recheck_scans
title: Recheck Scans
